'''Dogran''' was a [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Major/Legends|major]] in the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial Military]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] who served in the [[Battle of Ilum]]. Dogran served under [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Ilyan Regus]] and [[Darth Malgus]] during Operation Dark Ice.

During the Battle of Ilum, Dogran was authorized to compensate the Imperials who had slain the [[Kaleesh/Legends|Kaleesh]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Gelrex]] and his warriors.<ref name="Operation Dark Ice">{{TORcite|type=message|Operation Dark Ice|Major Dogran on behalf of Grand Moff Regus}}</ref>
